title: Webhooks and API clients calling a Vercel preview URL get a Vercel login page instead of the function
symptoms: Stripe, Slack, or GitHub webhook deliveries to a preview URL fail with 401 or a redirect to vercel.com/login
Slack URL verification fails for a preview deployment
Playwright or curl against a preview sees the Vercel Authentication page
cause: Standard Protection with Vercel Authentication covers every non production deployment URL, so callers without a Vercel session are redirected to log in. Third party senders cannot pass that check.
fix: Create a Protection Bypass for Automation secret and send it as the x-vercel-protection-bypass header, or as a query parameter for services that cannot set headers.
affected: Vercel projects with Standard Protection and Vercel Authentication (the common default), all plans, as of October 2026
